# v4.4.7 response isolation evidence

This leaf preserves 40 preregistered, distinct response-only cases at source
revision dcbc75b4a69ef2d7dfc39e582afd005dc2264b0c. It does not run the frozen
294-response comparison or establish efficiency, package adoption, installed-host
acceptance, product operation or model reliability.

The separate E4-AM1 amendment appends only the exact original E3 observation to
make E4’s omitted antecedent explicit. It retains E4 source, request and P1, uses
the frozen prompt hash, and permits exactly one response after parent diagnosis
verification. Original E4 remains unqualified. This is a distinct input probe,
not a source repair, identical-input retry or reliability claim.

`protocol.json`, `isolation-inputs.json` and `frozen-bindings.json` were written
before the first native request. Each corrected prompt losslessly decodes to its
paired legacy instruction, request and observations. Actual native sent text is
checked separately for zero raw dollar bytes. This closes the tested mention
selection boundary; the fully assembled model context remains unexposed.

`isolation-captures/` retains native raw transcripts, exact responses, controls,
telemetry and result envelopes. `acceptedCapture` means capture integrity only.
Independent semantic and authority decisions belong to the parent. Review every
actual response against its frozen source and rubric before advancing acceptance;
mechanical checks do not certify behavior.

`reuse-assessment.json` retains seven independently accepted zero-dollar helper
captures (L3 and L6, three each; P10) and the three independently accepted mobile
transport cases MT1–MT3. No existing mobile response is recaptured. Original B8,
MR1–MR3 and all other historical failures remain unchanged.

`infrastructure-rejection.json` preserves an initial host egress rejection before
execution. `authorization-resolution.json` records the approved resubmission using
the direct user attachment. No request was sent before that approval. Configured
model, reasoning, sandbox and approval controls remain unchanged.

`assessment.json` reports measured collection results and pending independent
review. `capture-audit.json` checks actual native transport and capture controls.
`artifact-bindings.json` binds every leaf artifact except itself and the promotion
inventory. `promotion-files.json` lists regular files and hashes for parent-owned
copying; it excludes itself to avoid circular hashes and rejects symlinks or known
credential patterns. The parent separately binds the inventory and maps original
ignored paths to durable fixture paths.

Run the original leaf oracle from /github/skills:

```sh
node .unlazy/release-447/response/verify.mjs
```

It emits LEAF_BINDINGS_OK only after all assertions pass. Its import/repository
locations describe the original ignored location. Preserve those source bytes and
derive a portable verifier with an explicit relocation map when promoting. Native
absolute cwd/process paths remain historical observations, never replay assumptions.
